generator: map_plan_v18.py (v16 crowd builder, crowd_v12 algorithms; v17+v18 props, haystacks, wells, pools as obstacles)

coordinates.origin: bottom-left corner of the map frame
coordinates.district_outline_policy: organic neighbourhood envelopes; intervening common landscape, roads and water are not extra districts

runtime_contract.spawn_policy: All player cameras must fail LOS for 2s; >=25m from each player; defer visible spawn/despawn.
runtime_contract.profile_policy: town_walker/police avoid all source sand; beach_walker may use dry access links.
runtime_contract.movement_policy: Follow exported corridors; NavMesh shortest paths may cut roads.
runtime_contract.apron_policy: Aprons/verges are proposed walks on existing ground, not new paving.
runtime_contract.witness_policy: Eyes are overlapping estimates; actual runtime LOS is required.
